validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: real, established by a specific named row in a credible primary source. The row's ONLY gem.wiki citation is OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletin 2017 (aggregate report). I downloaded the working PDF (https://www.opec.org/assets/assetdb/asb-2017.pdf) and read Table 9.9 'Main gas pipelines in OPEC Members, 2016' directly (Iraq section, PDF footer p.133-134). It lists a discrete row: 'Trans-Iraqi dry gas pipeline / Daura PWR St | OPC | 29 | 18' -- i.e. NOT a generic aggregate; it names this specific branch with its own length and diameter. So GEM's 'Trans-Iraqi-Daura Gas Pipeline' is a GEM-constructed name for the OPEC connection 'Trans-Iraqi dry gas pipeline -> Daura power station'. CAVEAT: this is a SINGLE source, 2016 vintage, and no independent web source names this specific line (extensive EN + system-level searches found nothing beyond GEM/OPEC-derived material). url_verifier cannot validate the OPEC PDF (returns 200 but does not extract PDF text), so the primary source is documented here but not placed in proposed_refs. The broader SYSTEM is independently corroborated: OPC (Oil Pipelines Company, under the Iraq Ministry of Oil) per its 1999 charter operates dry-gas pipelines carrying gas from production sources to power stations (iraq-businessnews, iraqieconomists.net), which supports both plausibility and classification. CLASSIFICATION: correct -- a dry GAS transmission lateral (18 in, 29 mi), feeding the Al-Dora power station; not oil/NGL, not plant-internal gathering. Fuel=Gas confirmed by OPEC's 'dry gas pipeline' wording. Caveat: it is a feeder/spur to one power station, consistent with GEM's convention of entering each OPEC Table-9.9 row as its own pipeline. DUPLICATE: distinct OPEC row -- the entire GEM Iraq gas-operating cluster is a 1:1 transcription of OPEC ASB 2017 Table 9.9 (verified: P4062=Trans-Iraq/Hilla-2 25/24, P4064=Trans-Iraqi/Najaf 74/24, P4065=Trans-Iraqi/Dewania 50/24, P4066=Trans-Iraqi/Daura 29/18, P1845=Taji/South Baghdad 35/18, etc.), so P4066 is not an internal double-count of another OPEC-derived row. Possible PHYSICAL overlap with P4054 'Taji-Duara Gas Pipeline' (18-in, ->Al Rashid district, which contains Daura) -- but P4054's origin (Taji, north of Baghdad, cap 94, updated 2024) differs from P4066's (tap on the trans-Iraqi trunk south of Baghdad), so they are most likely two distinct feeders into the Daura/Karkh area; flagged for a human check, not asserted as a duplicate. ATTRIBUTION: Owner 'Iraq Ministry of Oil' 100% is correct (OPC is the ministry's operating arm); recommend adding operator = Oil Pipelines Company (OPC). Endpoints in the sheet are blank ('Iraq'->'Iraq'); real endpoints per OPEC are the Trans-Iraqi dry gas trunk (start) and Al-Dora / Daura Power Station, Karkh, southern Baghdad (end). SPEC: Length 29 mi and Diameter 18 in match OPEC EXACTLY, but single-source. Capacity is genuinely blank and OPEC gives none -- left UNRESOLVED, not forced. Overall: real + correctly classified, so confirmed with a single-source/stale-vintage caveat and blank endpoints.

routes.end_name: Al-Dora (Daura) Power Station, Karkh district, southern Baghdad, Baghdad Governorate
routes.corridor_desc: A ~29-mile (47 km) 18-inch dry-gas lateral tapping the Trans-Iraqi dry gas trunk and running into the Karkh/Al-Dora area of southern Baghdad to supply the Al-Dora power station (per OPEC ASB 2017 Table 9.9 'Trans-Iraqi dry gas pipeline / Daura PWR St'). The TERMINUS is firm and well located (Al-Dora power station, ~33.257N 44.378E, on the Tigris in south Baghdad). The ORIGIN is only loosely bounded: it is a junction on the trans-Iraqi/strategic dry-gas trunk somewhere within roughly 47 km south of Daura; the exact tie-in is not sourced and no route geometry could be traced, so lat/lon for the start are left null rather than fabricated. Overall a one-endpoint-firm, loosely-bounded corridor.
